description: This file defines a React functional component called Header, which implements the top navigation bar of a web application. It includes a brand link, a search input with associated logic, and a link to an external resource. The component manages state and effects related to search input, and handles navigation actions.

methods.name: Header()
methods.description: React functional component rendering the header with navigation, branding, and search functions.

methods.name: onSubmit
methods.description: Handles form submission to update search term and navigate to the home page.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears the search input and resets the search term, navigating to the home page if necessary.
